fact: On 29 April 2026 the commune of Owendo and the national tax directorate (DGI) signed a partnership to implement the Digitax application, aligning the town hall's directory of payers with the DGI's and enabling remote payment by transfer or mobile money.
title: Gabon/Digitax : convention de partenariat entre la Direction générale des Impôts et la mairie d'Owendo
